About

150 WORDS, NO ESSAY

I'm Yihe Lin, a 10th grader in Chengdu applying to U.S. boarding high schools. For three years I've hosted and produced the school radio; I shoot an ongoing photo series, Chengdu, 8:00 AM; and I write small games in Python. I care about media, storytelling, and cities. Right now I'm prepping for tests and interviews — and treating "getting ready to leave home" as a project of its own. This site is one page of it.

How I got here

GRAB & DRAG →
2010
Born in Chengdu
A city of teahouses and spice. My first word was allegedly "面" (noodles).

First film camera
A hand-me-down from my uncle. I immediately photographed 36 strangers' shoes.
2022
School radio host
Started as a filler voice, stayed as the producer. Now I train the 7th graders.
2024

Lost five rounds in a row, won the sixth at regionals. Still have the bracket sheet.

A dumpling-catching game for my cousin's birthday. She beat my high score. Unacceptable.
2026
Applying to the U.S.
This website is the extra page of my application. Thanks for reading this far.

02

Activities & Experience

CLICK TO EXPAND
A1

School Radio — Morning Show

Host & Producer — 40 episodes; trained 7 successors

2022 — NOW CLUB +
Background: the school's 15-minute morning show had an audience of almost nobody. What I did: rewrote school news as a movie trailer, added a weekly "one weird fact" segment, live at 8:00 AM every Tuesday. Result: 40 episodes and counting, doubled listenership, and 7 trained successors so the show outlives me.
A2

English Debate — Regional Champion

Debater — lost 5 rounds, won regionals on the 6th

2023 — NOW COMPETITION +
Background: first English debate, I was so nervous I said "lunch" instead of "rebuttal". What I did: reviewed every loss, built a 200-card argument bank. Result: won the regional championship on my sixth round. The bracket sheet is still my phone wallpaper.
A3

Swimming — Morning Practice

Team member — 10 years, never skipped morning practice

2016 — NOW SPORT +
Background: started at 6, no particular talent, not fast. What I did: made "never skip morning practice" the only goal, winter included. Result: top 8 at the city meet. Not impressive — but ten years, zero missed mornings. Persistence counts as speed.
A4

Teahouse Oral History Project

Founder — recorded 12 teahouse regulars' stories

2023 — NOW VOLUNTEER +
Background: my grandma's teahouse was closing; nobody was writing down the regulars' stories. What I did: brought a recorder and my camera every Saturday, using the interview skills from radio. Result: 12 elders, 9 hours of tape, cut into 6 special episodes — and printed photos delivered back to their subjects.
